newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday.

Spokesman Thierry Daman said that the European Commission had on Monday written to the United States authorities, expressing its concern over how it plans to implement the telecommunications agreement struck within the World Trade Organisation. In response to a question he said the text of the Commission letter was not available.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/742: Commission approves Scandairy joint venture between Swedish and Danish dairy cooperatives.
- IP/97/741: EU presses United States to change telecommunications rules.
- ME97/5.8: Commission says that in July 1997 industrial and consumer confidence increased significantly, leaving the economic sentiment indicator at its highest level for the past seven years.
